answer: In PoA, each challenge commits to a domain-separated transcript finalized only after a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse. The pulse’s unpredictable, collectively signed value derives the task seed, binding responses to onyx, trellis, and jetty cases without exposing them beforehand. Consequently, sybil swarms cannot precompute answers, farm offline, or select favorable timing; every participant must await the beacon and perform fresh work, while verification rejects modified commitments.
